nodes.description: Address state variable holding the contract owner/developer, assigned from msg.sender in the constructor.
Constructor of the contract; stores msg.sender as the developer address.
Constant function that derives three lucky numbers (1..10) from previous block hashes via looping modulo arithmetic.
Privileged function guarded by the is_developer modifier that destroys the contract via suicide(msg.sender).
Modifier that reverts with throw when msg.sender is not the stored developer address.
msg.sender read in the constructor; becomes the trusted developer account.
msg.sender read inside the is_developer modifier before any state-changing protected function body.
selfdestruct invocation suicide(msg.sender) that permanently destroys the contract and forwards the balance.
block.blockhash(targetBlock - 1 - blockNumber) used as a pseudo-randomness source; predictable/manipulable by miners.
Function parameter targetBlock, the block number whose hash seeds the lottery numbers.
Return array lotteryLuckyNumbers[3] accumulating the generated numbers.
Local bytes32 blockHash holding the result of block.blockhash for each iteration.
Local uint256 newRnd holding a derived candidate lucky number in the range 1..10.
Local uint8 currentN counting how many distinct lucky numbers have been accepted.
Local uint256 blockNumber loop counter walking backwards over past block hashes.
Local uint256 n selecting the 256-bit word inside the block hash via 256**n.
Local uint256 numbersCountNeeded fixed to 3, bounding the acceptance loop.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns msg.sender directly into the developer state variable.
Constructor reads msg.sender to initialize the owner.
Constructor execution path performs the write to developer.
generateLuckyNumbers calls block.blockhash repeatedly inside its loops.
targetBlock parameter is passed as the block number argument to block.blockhash.
Function signature consumes the targetBlock parameter.
Result of block.blockhash is stored into the local blockHash variable.
newRnd is computed by integer division and modulo of blockHash (uint256(blockHash)/256**n % 10 + 1).
Loop variable n selects the 256-bit word of blockHash used to derive newRnd.
Accepted newRnd value is written into the lotteryLuckyNumbers return array.
currentN indexes lotteryLuckyNumbers when storing and comparing accepted numbers.
numbersCountNeeded bounds the currentN acceptance loop.
blockNumber is subtracted in the expression targetBlock - 1 - blockNumber; if blockNumber exceeds targetBlock - 1 this uint256 subtraction underflows in Solidity 0.4.11.
is_developer modifier guards entry into del, gating the privileged selfdestruct.
Modifier compares msg.sender against developer and reverts on mismatch.
developer state variable is the trusted value used in the modifier's authorization check.
del executes suicide(msg.sender), permanently destroying the contract once the caller passes the developer check.
msg.sender validated by the modifier is the same address receiving the balance in suicide(msg.sender).

normalization_plan.reason: targetBlock is a function parameter of generateLuckyNumbers and has no independent semantics outside that function.
lotteryLuckyNumbers is the named return array populated by generateLuckyNumbers.
blockHash local only caches the result of the block.blockhash unsafe operation and should be folded into it.
newRnd is a transient loop scratch value computed and consumed entirely inside generateLuckyNumbers.
currentN is an internal loop counter of generateLuckyNumbers with no meaning outside it.
blockNumber is used solely to index past blocks for block.blockhash.
n is a local word-selector used only in the generateLuckyNumbers hashing loop.
numbersCountNeeded is a constant initialized inside generateLuckyNumbers and scoped to it.
